scripts.build: npm run clean:build && npm run build:vue-wrapper && npm run build:subPackages
scripts.build:vue-wrapper: npm run build:vue-wrapper:lib && npm run build:vue-wrapper:typings
scripts.build:vue-wrapper:lib: vite build -c vite.config.package.mts && cp ../../LICENSE.md ../../OSS_NOTICE projects/vue-wrapper/README.md projects/vue-wrapper/package.json ../components/CHANGELOG.md dist/vue-wrapper/
scripts.build:subPackages: npm run build:subPackages:lib && npm run build:subPackages:stylesheets && npm run build:subPackages:tailwindcss && npm run build:subPackages:vanilla-extract && npm run build:subPackages:typings && npm run build:subPackages:skill
scripts.build:subPackages:skill: npm run build:subPackages:skill:content && npm run build:subPackages:skill:bin
scripts.build:subPackages:skill:content: SOURCE=../storefront/projects/skills/generated/vue/skills && TARGET=./dist/vue-wrapper/skills && test -f $SOURCE/pds-knowledge-vue/SKILL.md || { echo 'Missing staged vue skill. Run npm run build:skills first.' >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf $TARGET && cp -r $SOURCE $TARGET
scripts.build:subPackages:skill:bin: SOURCE=../storefront/projects/skills/bin/pds-skill.js && TARGET=./dist/vue-wrapper/bin && test -f $SOURCE || { echo "Missing canonical pds-skill binary at $SOURCE." >&2; exit 1; }; rm -rf $TARGET && mkdir -p $TARGET && cp $SOURCE $TARGET/pds-skill.js && chmod +x $TARGET/pds-skill.js
scripts.build:subPackages:typings: npm run build:subPackages:typings:jsdom-polyfill && npm run build:subPackages:typings:partials && npm run build:subPackages:typings:testing && npm run build:subPackages:typings:tokens && npm run build:subPackages:typings:emotion && npm run build:subPackages:typings:vanilla-extract && npm run build:subPackages:typings:ag-grid && npm run build:subPackages:typings:meta
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:vrt && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:smoke:unit && npm run test:smoke:vue-wrapper
